issues: Subject input, Description textarea and Category/Priority selects lack data-testid attributes (e.g. sr-subject, sr-description, sr-category, sr-priority). Modal is functional but sub-optimal for automated testing. Cancel/Raise Request buttons also missing data-testid.

action_items: LOW PRIORITY: Add data-testid attributes to support modal form fields (sr-subject, sr-category, sr-priority, sr-description, sr-submit, sr-cancel) for deterministic E2E coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: amc.book_service correctly performs wallet check BEFORE creating maintenance_task, preventing orphan tasks on 402; pricing is centralized in PRICE_TABLE and defaults to 500 for unknown categories via suggested_price().

scheduler dedupe via scheduler_runs collection keyed by (client_id, YYYY-MM-DD) is idempotent and safe for multiple daily triggers; AsyncIOScheduler started from server.py on_startup and stopped cleanly on shutdown.
reports.compliance_pdf streams via BytesIO and sets Content-Disposition properly; handles empty sites/assets/inspections gracefully with placeholder text.
demo._ensure_demo_tenant is idempotent (won't duplicate user) and demo_reset is correctly scoped by client_id + demo=True flag — Acme regression confirms cross-tenant immunity.

core.notify.notify defaults severity from SEVERITY_BY_KIND when not explicitly passed — back-compat safe; legacy pre-Phase-3 notifs may have no severity field (frontend should default to 'info' when missing).
support.update_request auth matrix is correct: super_admin any, client_admin same-tenant via {id,client_id} query, anything else → 403; cross-tenant client→404 because query misses.
server.py still returns status='operational' for backward-compat with iteration-2 tests (was iteration-3 action_item) — good.
